title: Australian Grilled Sirloin Steak Wrap
description: A flavorful and quick meal featuring grilled sirloin steak wrapped in a warm tortilla.
instructions: Season sirloin steak with salt and pepper.
Grill steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches a safe internal temperature of 130°F - 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Meanwhile, toast the tortilla on the grill for 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until it is warm and pliable.
Assemble the wrap by spreading Australian aioli on the tortilla, then adding sliced steak, lettuce, tomato, red onion, and cilantro (if using).
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling and serve immediately.
